text:
deploy-bot: Heads-up: rolling release `release/2026-03-22-3` to prod in ~15m. Will flip feature @cohort_swap from 0% -> 5% immediately, target 25% over 30m. Model pinned: `model-llm-v2.1` for this cohort. Watch signals: 95th latency, request_error_rate, and production eval mismatch. If error_rate > 2% absolute or latency +200ms P95, we auto-dry-run rollback. Release notes: https://go/release/2026-03-22-3 :rocket:

alyssa: quick ask — can we hold the EU region at 0% until we validate CORS fixes? seen sporadic 400s earlier.

sam: agree with alyssa. telemetry team: set a hard guardrail that blocks ramp beyond 5% for EU if 400+ errors spike. what are current baselines?

jia: preflight checklist completed. Canary (us-west) at 5% for last 10m, errors 0.2%, latency ok. I can run the cohort drain command if we need to scale back: `/deploy flag set cohort_swap 0 --reason="rollback suspect"`

matt: SRE watchlist: set circuit-breaker to trip at 1.5% error over 2m, and add a shadow route to `model-llm-v2.0` for immediate pin fallback. Command to pin: `/infra pin-model model-llm-v2.0 --scope=cohort_swap`

olivia: product note — if we pause EU, please annotate rollout with `eu-delay` tag so analytics knows the split. Also add a short blurb to the release notes about A/B metric differences.

ops-bot: preflight checks: quotas ✔, infra-health ✔, secrets ✔, canary-telemetry link: https://go/telemetry/run/6854321999-c1

deploy-bot: Starting 5% flip to global cohort_swap now. Will emit updates every 5m. Rolling window: 00:15 -> 00:45 UTC.

alyssa: noted. holding EU at 0% now — canary will remain us regions only. pls confirm ramp policy updated.

sam: telemetry thresholds set: `error_rate_block=0.02, p95_latency_delta_ms=200`. Alerts bound to #eng-oncall and paging.

jia: if we need an immediate rollback, use this quick command (exec perms required):
```
/deploy rollback --release=release/2026-03-21-9 --flags="cohort_swap:0" --note="auto-rollback-on-error"
```

matt: also enabling soft-eject: route 30% of the failing cohort traffic to read-only path while we investigate. That avoids full service interruption.

deploy-bot: Update @here: 5% flip complete (timestamp: 6854322500). Observed metrics: error_rate 0.25% (stable), p95 +12ms. No guardrail triggered. Next step: increase to 10% in 10m if stable.

alyssa: 👍 good. keeping EU paused. please call out any 4xx spikes.

olivia: tagging analytics: please watch conversion delta on cohort_swap — if conversion drops >3pp at 10% we stop ramp.

sam: adding a quick smoke test run in EU-backend to validate the CORS path before we unpause. ETA 8m.

deploy-bot: 10m check: ramp to 10% now (timestamp: 6854322900). If system stays green, target 25% at 00:45 UTC.

ops-bot: roll-forward note: `model-pin` remains v2.1. fallback v2.0 ready at /infra. Audit log entry created: audit/685432.log

deploy-bot: 25% target reached (timestamp: 6854323022). Status: overall error_rate 0.4%, p95 +18ms. No automatic rollback. EU remains held at 0%. Marking rollout as partial-deployed. Please update postmortem or notes if any manual interventions required. :tada:
